summary: New issues surfaced in hyphy_fel with 3 runtime failures and in samtools_slice_bam across 3 tests. The "History not found" error in samtools_slice_bam likely points to a test setup or history creation issue where the required history fixture was missing or deleted before execution. Long-standing shared issues remain stable, including internal Galaxy utility job failures affecting 17 tests across 15 tools and missing server test input data affecting 16 tests across 7 tools. A major shared infrastructure failure seen in recent runs has resolved, clearing the vast majority of previously failing tests.
